title: Right side view
statementMd:
Return the values visible when looking at the tree from the right side (the last node on each level), top to bottom. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `right_side_view([1, 2, 3, null, 5, null, 4])` returns `[1, 3, 4]`.
hints: Take the last element of each level.
